download_method: POST official file_down form to https://www.histdata.com/get.php; form token not published
source_timezone: fixed UTC-05:00 (EST); no daylight saving time
conversion: add exactly 5 hours and partition by UTC minute/month; source 2019-12 included for the left UTC boundary
equal_timestamps: all source records retained; source order breaks equal-time ties
out_of_order_timestamps: open is earliest timestamp, close latest; OHLC extremes across all received ticks; counts of backward transitions reported per source archive
n_ticks: source record count, not the source volume column
prices: decimal integer representation at 1e-9; output keeps at least 5 decimal places and all source precision up to 9; no reconstructed ask
missing_minutes: enumerated over every UTC minute, including weekends and holidays; no interpolation, forward-fill or inference that an absent source tick certifies market closure
aggregation_runtime: C++17, standard library; archive decompression and SHA256 via Python standard library
